# descope_embeddedlink_settings (Resource)

Manages the project-level embedded link authentication settings. This is a singleton resource, and its id is always the project ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that these settings belong to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Setting this to `true` will disallow using embedded link authentication directly via API and SDK calls. Note that this does not affect authentication flows that are configured to use embedded links.
- `expiration_time` (String) How long the embedded link remains valid before it expires.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
